memory_scope: Combined server process trees and descendants at 200 ms; excludes launcher/probe, OS page cache, unrelated processes.
method: Seed A, cross-worktree read B, independent changed cache-off controls without uploads, concurrent divergent writers, concurrent clean readers, swap changes and cross-read minimal/toplevel. Shutdown and clean with zero graph before every build. Controls precede cache-on changed builds. Existing external downloads copied with known-root symlinks relocated; no local action/output state copied.

protocol_events.event: Initial relocated-external seed build succeeded but rejected publication for inputs changing during the invocation. Preserve failure. Stabilize B with cache off, then retry A seed without source/product changes.

Both controls completed successfully. Parser did not understand synthetic terminal retry-summary records (proto field 9, correlated by rpc_id). Recover control B from BEP/log/output; retain raw evidence, explicitly mark unavailable phase memory samples and timing source. Continue without rerunning completed controls. Add a remote-metadata population pass after local changed actions, which are intentionally ineligible for execution reuse until observed remote-backed.

Concurrent writer pair failed with remote GetCapabilities connection refused; exit 34 included failed BES upload. Other user-authorized LAN/BES task enabled BES in future harness launches and reported an appliance restart/licensing connectivity outage. Preserve its BES setting. Retry only after /healthz returns HEALTHY; same SkyCache and source variants, no product changes or cache reset.

Second pair encountered repeated remote connection resets and failed BES; A produced correct output and published, B did not. Preserve failed pair. Parser now permits non-retrying RPCs without rpc_id (counts them explicitly). Bound only remote transfers to one connection with 16 concurrent requests per server; retain two concurrent builds, same source edits/cache/jobs/heap, and user-authorized BES. This isolates local SkyCache concurrency from unbounded remote transport pressure; it is not a default-network-concurrency pass.
